The tour immersed the senior leaders in the 31st Fighter Wing mission, provided an opportunity to recognize outstanding Airmen and focused on quality-of-life initiatives for overseas service members and their families. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Parker Dummer)

items.title: Helping Military Families Prepare for the New School Year
items.description: As the new school year approaches, Kenner Army Health Clinic is helping military families prepare by encouraging early school physicals and required immunizations. The Pediatrics team will host two appointment-only Back-to-School Bash events, giving families an opportunity to complete school health requirements and ensure children are healthy, safe and ready to learn.
